task_completion.description: The CTChest.nrrd (or CT-chest.nrrd) volume is loaded into 3D Slicer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D Slicer interface shows a chest CT scan in the slice viewers; the Data module or volume selector shows 'CTChest' or 'CT-chest'.

task_completion.description: The agent focuses on or maximizes the Coronal slice viewer (typically the green-bordered slice).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Coronal slice view is visible and active, or the layout is changed to show the coronal plane prominently.

task_completion.description: The slice viewer mode is changed from 'None' to 'Slab' or 'MIP'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the slice controller options (often accessed via the pin icon or 'Volumes' module), the rendering mode is set to 'Slab' or 'Maximum Intensity Projection'.

task_completion.description: The slab thickness is set to at least 30mm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A numeric input or slider for 'Slab Thickness' in the slice controller or Volumes module displays a value of 30.0 or greater.

task_completion.description: The coronal view displays a Maximum Intensity Projection (MIP) characteristic (vessels and bones appear brighter/denser through the slab).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The coronal image shows thick-slice characteristics where multiple anatomical structures are projected onto one plane, appearing denser than a standard 1mm slice.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the coronal MIP view to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' dialog or 'Screen Capture' module is visible with the path '~/Documents/SlicerData/Exports/chest_mip_coronal.png' entered, or a terminal/python console command confirms the save to that specific path.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the 3D Slicer GUI elements rather than just executing a single script to finish the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor moving to menus, sliders being adjusted, or the 'Volumes' module panel being manipulated.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing image or use a placeholder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the transition from a standard slice view to a thick-slab MIP view within the Slicer application.

integrity.description: The agent did not navigate to a folder containing a pre-existing 'chest_mip_coronal.png' and claim it as its own.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen actively configuring the Slab thickness and orientation settings in the Slicer UI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset 'CTChest.nrrd' is often listed in Slicer's Sample Data as 'CT-chest.nrrd'. For a valid MIP, the 'Slab Mode' must be set to 'Max' (Maximum Intensity Projection) and the 'Slab Thickness' must be ≥ 30mm. The coronal view is the green slice viewer.
